title: Progress of a running analysis
description: progress.json in the output directory of a Sobol run, an emulator training or a profile likelihood (libcuflynx.utilities.progress): how far the run is, rewritten by MPI rank 0 while it runs. A phase may carry further keys of its kind; a reader ignores those it does not know. schema_version goes up when a key changes meaning or is removed.

schema_version.description: The version of this file's layout.

state.description: running until the run's result files are written (done) or it raised an error (failed). A run that was killed stays running: compare updated with the clock.

started.description: When the run started: ISO 8601, UTC, to the second.

updated.description: When the file was last written: ISO 8601, UTC, to the second.

phases.description: The parts of the run, in the order they run. A phase is added when its size is known, so later phases can be missing while an earlier one runs.

name.description: sobol: sampling, local_jacobian, analysis. emulation: sampling (one phase per design stage) and training. profile_likelihood: the label of the calibrated entry profiled.

state.description: queued until the phase's first item is done; failed when the run failed while it was running.

done.description: Items finished, the failed ones included.

total.description: Items in the phase. An emulation's training phase has 0 until the models to compare are known.

failed.description: Of the items done, those that failed: a simulation that did not converge or gave an output that is not finite, a profile point with no finite cost, an emulator that could not be fitted.

stage.description: emulation, sampling: the design stage, from 1.

method.description: emulation, sampling: the stage's sampling method.

param_index.description: profile_likelihood: the index of the profiled entry in params_for_id.

metric.description: emulation, training: the metric each model's score is in; null until the first model is done.

models.description: emulation, training: the emulators compared, in the order they are fitted.

score.description: The model's held-out value of the phase's metric; null until it is done.

duration_s.description: Seconds the model took; null until it is done, and for a model that failed (its time is counted in the next one that finishes).
